data.narrative:
Unseenlabs is a Series C space & aerospace company founded by Benjamin, Jonathan, and Clément Galic that has raised €112.5M to date. Valuation analysis relies on a comparable universe of 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and one additional peer), supplemented by reference to 5 public space & aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) that trade at a median 27.4x price-to-sales.

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the €112.5M ($112M equivalent) total raised, implying a valuation of $191M. Peer-median analysis across the 6 comparable private companies yields a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.1B (minimum) to $8.0B (maximum). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of Unseenlabs' disclosed revenue.

Triangulating the two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $163M (low) to $2.1B (high), with a median of $991M. The wide spread reflects material tension between stage-progression anchored to capital deployed and peer median valuations driven by later-stage, well-capitalized competitors. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and mission success metrics relative to peers. The peer-median method carries greater weight given Stage C's demonstrated risk reduction, though the stage-progression floor provides a conservative disciplinary bound.
